conjectures.scope: Crossing is a proposed mathematical interface, not automatic equality, inversion, adjunction or equivalence of all maps.
conjectures.acceptance: Actual incoming/outgoing types and source-supported crossing maps, with declared identities/composition or weaker comparison witnesses.
conjectures.falsifier: An arrow is reversed without an inverse witness, a many-to-one readout is treated as reversible, or the two sides have incompatible domains.
conjectures.blocker: Crossing semantics and field-to-rung4 binding absent.
conjectures.reopen_when: Both typed prerequisites are constructed.

conjectures.statement: The downward four-dimensional/rung4 construction realizes a proton-like structure.
conjectures.scope: Proton-like must name the retained native geometry, field/projector structure or operation interface; resemblance and dimension alone are insufficient. Physical particle identification is separate.
conjectures.acceptance: An explicit map to the specified native P structure preserving the declared geometry, metric, projectors, attachments and allowed operations, or a clearly bounded subset of these.
conjectures.falsifier: Only a tetrahedral picture or a count is matched, or rank/phase/continuation distinctions are erased.
conjectures.blocker: No typed downward construction or chosen meaning of proton-like supplied.
conjectures.reopen_when: The crossing supplies a downward map and its exact preservation task.

conjectures.statement: The specified upward construction has exactly twelve paths under a fixed length bound of at most three steps.
conjectures.scope: No path-count verdict until source/target, transition, cost and equivalence conventions are fixed. Twelve paths, twelve patches and rung12 are different quantities.
conjectures.acceptance: Exhaustive source-generated enumeration through length3, retained endpoints/words and cost witnesses, completeness certificate for the declared bounded domain, and exactly twelve admitted classes or words under the preregistered convention.
conjectures.falsifier: A missing or extra admitted path, a longer primitive word hidden inside a counted step, or an unlicensed quotient that forces twelve.
conjectures.blocker: The path/counting contract is unspecified.
conjectures.reopen_when: The source graph and counting convention are frozen; test mismatching counts without retrospective repair.

conjectures.statement: Rung4 is a domain/codomain crossing with a proton-like downward realization and twelve upward paths in at most three declared steps.
conjectures.scope: Composite operator conjecture, associated with but not evidence for the instrument-simplex conjecture.
conjectures.acceptance: All three witnesses use the same source, crossing and direction conventions, with operation/endpoint compatibility.
conjectures.falsifier: Any conjunct fails on that shared contract, or the witnesses require incompatible conventions.
conjectures.blocker: All three constituent witnesses remain open.
conjectures.reopen_when: Compatible source-bound crossing, downward and upward witnesses exist.

conjectures.statement: Specify the integer repetition law around centers of the selected PNE-solid shape class.
conjectures.scope: Translation, dilation, rotation about a center and native accessibility are different maps.
conjectures.acceptance: Declare the shape-centered decorated data, translation periods or scale factors, transport action, exact/approximate criterion and source-defined center family before testing.
conjectures.falsifier: Integer lattice coordinates are treated as proof of radial self-similarity or arbitrary-center rotational symmetry.
conjectures.next_test: After the shape specification, extract candidate center-to-center translations or scale maps and freeze the repeat test; geometry and field-sewing gates remain separate.
conjectures.blocker: The selected PNE solid and center rule are not specified.
conjectures.reopen_when: The intended repeat law and its domain have been typed.

conjectures.statement: A declared integer translation lattice repeats the full decorated field, possibly through a specified frame transport.
conjectures.scope: Geometry translation covariance alone does not supply global field sewing, exact phase return or native window accessibility.
conjectures.acceptance: Primitive periods, source-defined field transports and their composition law; equality or equivariance is explicitly distinguished, with preserved attachments and origin/phase conventions.
conjectures.falsifier: An admitted translated contact has incompatible field data or nontrivial unaccounted phase/holonomy.
conjectures.blocker: Full decorated source and period/transport contract absent.
conjectures.reopen_when: Period contract and tested field attachments are available.

conjectures.statement: A declared integer dilation or coarse-graining realizes the same relevant structure at larger scale.
conjectures.scope: Not implied by translation periodicity or by the inclusion kL in L for an integer lattice.
conjectures.acceptance: Source-derived scale/coarse-graining maps, normalization and retained information, intertwining the named operations and attachments across at least one independently specified scale comparison.
conjectures.falsifier: Only vertex counts repeat while metric, cyclic ordering, coupling or admissible operations change without a declared transport.
conjectures.blocker: No scaling operation or coarse-graining interface is supplied.
conjectures.reopen_when: A concrete scaling law and its preservation task are given.

conjectures.statement: Construct the source-defined center family of copies of the selected self-closing PNE solid.
conjectures.scope: Only this one declared shape class and its admitted marked/oriented copies; no arbitrary-center claim remains active.
conjectures.acceptance: An equivariant center rule, actual constructed shape instances and their incidence/orientation data, with the center domain fixed independently of a desired period count.
conjectures.falsifier: A center is chosen after seeing a desired period, or inequivalent shapes are silently pooled.
conjectures.blocker: No selected closed solid and center construction supplied.
conjectures.reopen_when: A source-supported solid and center rule are available.

conjectures.statement: The proposed integer repeat law preserves the specified structure outward from the declared centers.
conjectures.scope: Repetition only around centers of the selected PNE-solid shape. Translation and dilation remain competing interpretations; neither follows from rung labels or internal S5 geometry.
conjectures.acceptance: One explicitly selected repeat law and its center-domain witness, with source operations and field transport retained.
conjectures.falsifier: The selected branch fails for an admitted copy of the specified solid, or distinct shape/frame classes are conflated to force a repeat.
conjectures.blocker: Repetition semantics and source-supported branch remain open.
conjectures.reopen_when: The chosen branch and center witness are supplied.

conjectures.statement: A truncated octahedron has36 geometric edges partitioned12+12+12 by coordinate-plane direction families and tiles Euclidean3-space by BCC-lattice translations.
conjectures.scope: 24 vertices,36 edges,14 faces; geometric candidate only. No P/N/E assignment, field sewing, atomic-number identification or native construction follows.
conjectures.acceptance: Exact hull and edge census plus all-lattice Voronoi inequalities and nearest-lattice-point coverage argument.
conjectures.falsifier: A count, facet bisector or infinite-lattice redundancy bound fails.
conjectures.reopen_when: The proposed36 count denotes something other than geometric edges or the target geometry changes.

conjectures.statement: Candidate: a convex36-geometric-edge solid, including the truncated octahedron, is an exact union of complete primitives of the current fixed subdivision.
conjectures.scope: Actual two regular and four split-octahedron templates, no cuts or subdivision changes; nonconvex solids and field-coordinate counts remain unexcluded.
conjectures.acceptance: An exact whole-cell union with the candidate boundary.
conjectures.falsifier: Only6 unoriented primitive face-normal classes are available, so convex unions have at most12 facets and30 geometric edges. The truncated octahedron requires7 normal classes and14 facets.
conjectures.reopen_when: A separately authorized primitive/subdivision change, cell-cutting construction, nonconvex candidate or different36-count interpretation is supplied.

conjectures.statement: Each native36-coordinate baryon chart has an exact source-derived12-by-3 support grid and three12-coordinate column blocks.
conjectures.scope: Full coefficient and induced-metric factorization; P and N exchange fine/coarse roles. The columns are not P,N,E sectors: E has8 raw coordinates. No geometric edge-to-field map or PNE solid is constructed.
conjectures.acceptance: Fresh exact native coefficient reconstruction, singleton row/column intersections and retained coordinate labels, metric and source fingerprints.
conjectures.falsifier: Any coefficient, metric factorization, support partition or raw dimension fails.
conjectures.reopen_when: Native coordinate, metric, projector or count interpretation changes.

conjectures.statement: Specify a P/N/E triple, candidate self-closing solid, admissible assembly operations and center rule.
conjectures.scope: A candidate constructor, not a derived shape or physical particle identification. Geometry, native-contact completion and field closure are separate requirements.
conjectures.acceptance: Explicit ambient space and dimension, component and interface types, candidate boundary complex, role/occupancy rules, closure criteria and an equivariant center definition; a bounded search domain fixed before enumeration.
conjectures.falsifier: Three carrier names replace a gluing rule, a convex hull replaces actual cells, or batch operations are silently decomposed into illegal singleton steps.
conjectures.next_test: The native baryon field has an exact12x3 partition, not three PNE sectors; the convex36-edge whole-cell branch is excluded. Keep the intended count interpretation open until a source-defined PNE assembly and count/readout map are supplied. Freeze a bounded remaining candidate's closure and center tests without silently changing primitives.
conjectures.reopen_when: The constructor and bounded test domain are specified.

conjectures.statement: P/N/E triples assemble by admitted operations into the selected geometrically self-closing solid.
conjectures.scope: Geometric enclosure and actual native contact closure, not yet field sewing or infinite tiling.
conjectures.acceptance: Actual cell/face incidence, compatible orientation, nondegenerate enclosed geometry and appropriate manifold/boundary checks, plus replayable native operations closing all required contact obligations.
conjectures.falsifier: A hole, nonmanifold or overlapping interface, illegal role/occupancy assignment or unresolved native contact; the identity boundary-of-boundary=0 alone is insufficient.
conjectures.blocker: The solid and closure protocol are not yet specified.
conjectures.reopen_when: The specified bounded constructor produces a witness or a decisive obstruction.

conjectures.statement: The candidate PNE solid closes with its full declared field and attachment structure, not only its geometry or rank-one return.
conjectures.scope: Metric, patch/cycle, reference/phase and admitted-contact data are retained. Any permitted holonomy or internal/geometric distinction is explicit.
conjectures.acceptance: Actual compatible P/N/E interface maps and required loop/face comparisons at certified atomic assembly boundaries; no automatic identification of the obstructed PN geometric C3 actions.
conjectures.falsifier: A full-field sewing residual survives despite matching return readouts, or an unproved field map is admitted from geometric contact alone.
conjectures.blocker: No candidate solid with fully specified field interfaces yet.
conjectures.reopen_when: The constructed solid has actual field attachments and a frozen closure task.

conjectures.statement: Admitted copies of the selected self-closing PNE solid repeat throughout and cover the specified ambient space.
conjectures.scope: The ambient tessellation, realized spacetime and field-state S5 are not interchangeable. Full coverage is stronger than local closure or several successful placements; overlap exclusion is a separate stronger claim.
conjectures.acceptance: A source-defined placement family and exact coverage proof, for example a finite fundamental-domain argument with certified translations and boundary handling; every point/cell of the declared target domain is covered.
conjectures.falsifier: A gap, inadmissible required placement, unbounded uncovered region or a finite patch extrapolated to the whole space without a completeness argument.
conjectures.blocker: No selected solid, center/placement family or ambient-space coverage argument.
conjectures.reopen_when: A candidate placement rule and a source-derived finite-to-global coverage criterion are available.

conjectures.statement: Stronger candidate: the space-cover is a face-to-face tiling with disjoint interiors and legal shared interfaces.
conjectures.scope: An additional hypothesis, not silently included in the user's coverage wording.
conjectures.acceptance: Exact intersection/overlap classification for all placement orbits, common-face incidence and orientation, and local finiteness; no unintended overlaps or illegal occupancy.
conjectures.falsifier: Any two admitted tiles overlap in their interiors or meet incompatibly with the specified cell/interface structure.
conjectures.blocker: Coverage and actual placement family are unresolved.
conjectures.reopen_when: Coverage is established and intersections can be exhaustively reduced to source-defined relative placement classes.

conjectures.statement: The geometric PNE cover carries globally compatible full field/attachment data under its declared repetition law.
conjectures.scope: Geometry coverage does not imply field closure, path independence or physical realization.
conjectures.acceptance: Compatible shared-interface maps, declared loop/higher coherence, preserved relative modes and reference/phase data, with a uniform construction over the entire admitted cover.
conjectures.falsifier: A nonzero unaccounted contact/loop residual or a locally valid field assignment with no compatible global extension.
conjectures.blocker: Geometric cover and actual local/global field comparisons absent.
conjectures.reopen_when: Coverage, local sewing and the complete repeat transport are supplied.

conjectures.statement: After the specified descent to rung4, its instrument spaces form a2- or3-simplex comparison structure, with spacetime one vertex and electromagnetism another.
conjectures.scope: Operator conjecture. Other vertices and simplex interpretation remain unselected; no physical or topological parent verdict imported.
conjectures.acceptance: Actual descent and sector bindings plus one witnessed simplex branch, with all overlap/coherence data and its applicability domain retained.
conjectures.falsifier: The declared source supports no candidate branch, required sector maps fail, or a chosen higher comparison has a proved obstruction. Failure of one branch alone does not refute the other.
conjectures.blocker: Realization, vertices, edge/face data and physical bindings absent.
conjectures.reopen_when: A branch and all common prerequisites have source-supported witnesses.

recommendation_basis: Full anchored-packet orbits retain precisely the declared context quotient, whereas both averaging choices merge additional phase distinctions. Test finite source-bound invariant readouts on the native relative sector next, retaining exact orbit separation rather than selecting a context or fitting a cardinality.
